Lint a Container Specification for Reproducibility and Security Issues

Source: R/lint.R
lint_container_spec.Rd

Performs static analysis on a Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, or Apptainer .def recipe, accepting an rcapsule_spec object, a file path, or a character vector of spec lines. Checks for unpinned :latest or untagged base images, missing apt cache cleanup, root-only execution, cache-busting COPY order, hardcoded secrets, privileged containers, and missing safety guards.

Usage

lint_container_spec(
  spec,
  type = c("auto", "dockerfile", "compose", "apptainer")
)

Arguments

spec

An rcapsule_spec object (from compile_dockerfile(), compile_compose(), or compile_apptainer()), a path to a spec file, or a character string/vector containing the specification text.

type

Spec format: "auto" (default) infers from class, file name, or contents; or explicitly "dockerfile", "compose", or "apptainer".

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_lint with fields:

  • spec_type: "dockerfile", "compose", or "apptainer"

  • passed: logical (TRUE when n_errors == 0L)

  • n_errors, n_warnings, n_info: integer counts

  • issues: tibble::tibble() with columns rule_id, severity, line, message, and suggestion

Examples

bad_df <- c(
  "FROM rocker/r-ver:latest",
  "RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y libcurl4-openssl-dev",
  "COPY . ."
)
lint_container_spec(bad_df, type = "dockerfile")
#> 
#> ── rcapsule Container Lint (dockerfile): FAIL ──────────────────────────────────
#> Errors: 2 | Warnings: 2 | Info: 2
#> ✖ [DF001] (line 1) Base image 'rocker/r-ver:latest' uses mutable ':latest' tag.
#> ! [DF002] (line 2) apt-get install without cleaning /var/lib/apt/lists/* bloats image layers.
#> ! [DF003] (line 2) apt-get install missing '--no-install-recommends'.
#> ✖ [DF004] (line 1) Final stage has no non-root USER instruction; container runs as root.
#> ℹ [DF005] (line 1) No HEALTHCHECK instruction in final stage.
#> ℹ [DF009] (line 1) No WORKDIR instruction in final stage.
